title: Selector pack
description: Every locator the recorder needs for one chat surface, as data. Each element lists candidates tried in order; the first that matches wins. A pack never contains code.

id.description: lightning, messaging, or <surface>@v<api> for a pack that applies from that API version.

version.description: YYYY.MM.N: newer wins among packs for the same releases.

minApiVersion.description: The pack applies to orgs at this API version or later (until a pack with a higher minimum takes over).

verified.description: Where the pack was checked live (by afrec doctor) or against fixtures.

match.description: first (default): the first candidate that matches anything is used. any: an element matching any candidate counts (busy indicators, system events).

role.description: ARIA role (explicit or implicit for Playwright, explicit in page).

name.description: Case-insensitive regex on the accessible name (aria-label, title, text).

css.description: CSS selector (Playwright pierces open shadow roots).

tagPattern.description: Regex on the tag name (in page only).

classPattern.description: Regex on the class attribute (in page only).

text.description: Case-insensitive regex on the element's text.

title.description: Case-insensitive regex on the title attribute.

attr.description: Attribute name to regex (or true: present).

not.description: A candidate the element must NOT match.

source.description: Where the candidate came from: pack, healed, utam.
